claims: Aday Mara is the No. 15 for the 2025-26 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team.
Aday Mara is a junior center.
Aday Mara is from Zaragoza, Spain.
Aday Mara averages roughly 10-12 points per game for Michigan.
Aday Mara averages 7 rebounds per game for Michigan.
Aday Mara averages over 2.5 blocks per game for Michigan.
Aday Mara has approximately 67% field goal percentage for Michigan.
Aday Mara is the starting center for Michigan in the 2025-26 season.
Aday Mara is a leader in blocks in the Big Ten.
Aday Mara is a 5-star recruit in the 2023 class.
Aday Mara previously played for Casademont Zaragoza in Spain.
Aday Mara previously played for the Spanish National Team.
Aday Mara left UCLA for Michigan for a better team environment and playing experience, according to USA TODAY Sports and this YouTube video.
